full_details: Morning prayer at St Helen's ran to the sermon and past it. Master Thwaite stayed with the younger son. Mistress Ansell called an hour and a half timely. After dinner you packed two shirts, your mother's hose, the tables, and a quire. The lath sword went inside the grey cloak. The ribbons, the riddle-book, and the gloves were each their own knot, so that arriving would not begin as a quarrel. Brooke stayed on the shelf. Holinshed stayed under a cloth, against Gib. You told her you would carry her opinion of the forsworn gentlemen, and you did not say you had been saying the rest of it to the plaster. You wrote a list for Stratford and struck out half of it. The sixty shillings were still in the canvas. The bay was still not taken. The long page stayed face down on the board.
one_sentence: You heard the prodigal for an hour and a half, packed the gifts in separate knots, and left Brooke and Holinshed behind on purpose.
title: Heard the prodigal, and packed the gifts in four knots
